text: In March 2022, after being placed under EU sanctions, Dmitry Mazepin sold a controlling 52% stake in Uralchem and kept 48%.

source.name: Reuters (via Yahoo Finance): Mazepin sells controlling stake in Uralchem, resigns as CEO
source.quote: Dmitry Mazepin has resigned as CEO of Russian fertiliser producer Uralchem, the company said, and has sold a controlling stake after being placed on a European Union sanctions list.

additionalSources.name: Interfax: Mazepin reduces stake in UralChem to below 50%, steps down as CEO
additionalSources.quote: Russian businessman Dmitry Mazepin, who has been hit by European Union sanctions, has reduced his stake in the chemical producer to less than a controlling interest, the company reported.
